review_kind: read-only publication plan contract review; not implementation approval

findings.status: confirmed consequence if proposed in-place sanitation is applied while active
findings.issue: Each subsequent main run validates exact frozen artifact and expected-initial bytes, runtime source keys, saved configs and development/cache links. Even path-only edits to initial_shared or expected_main break the primary run contract.
findings.fix: Do not mutate live ART/WORK/source/model/config inputs. Complete all GPU jobs and original audits first; prepare a separate presentation projection and preserve the complete original evidence graph.

findings.status: confirmed provenance boundary, not an existing tampering finding
findings.issue: Published metadata projections no longer hash to original_raw_sha256/evidence_sha256/freeze_sha256. Rewriting those historical fields would falsely re-freeze sanitized bytes at the original experiment time.
findings.fix: Keep all scientific hash values and original freeze bytes unchanged. Add a new explicitly post-experiment original-to-published provenance manifest; verify each hash in its own byte domain.

findings.issue: The full audit CLI requires the live /tmp terrain cache and original raw hashes. Training audit additionally requires ignored logs, TensorBoard events, original YAML and installed runtime paths; it is not a public-checkout evaluation replay command.
findings.fix: Document separate stdlib-only public-byte verification plus audit_evaluation_records/compare_summary. Never weaken frozen full-audit checks or silently skip missing dependencies.

findings.issue: Installed package paths occur as dictionary keys; /tmp defaults are configuration values, and the Python/run-python executable is outside the repository. Blindly stripping root prefixes can create nonexistent purported repo files or key collisions.
findings.fix: Use a typed per-field transformation allowlist, collision checks and explicit external-runtime logical identifiers. If every identifier must refer to a real repo file, keep these runtime-only metadata originals private and publish a separately labelled projection rather than inventing locations.

contract.operational_boundary: No publication rewrites until all nine mains, all evaluation/demos and full original-byte audits have completed and no process can re-read operational metadata.
contract.immutable: All frozen 20 scientific source/provenance files, original scientific files, model bytes, numeric/boolean/null values, array shapes/order, dates, seeds, controller identities, gates and every original scientific SHA value remain unchanged.
contract.preferred_layout: Separate publication-view copies, never the active canonical evidence graph. If final publication places projections at original ART paths, do so only after immutable backup + original audit and explicitly classify those paths as projections no longer accepted by historical full-audit CLI.
contract.backup: Exclusive, complete byte copy under ignored WORK/publication_raw_backup with private inventory and original relative path hierarchy; include all linked raw/enriched/evaluation/training artifacts and log/config evidence needed for provenance. Do not copy live partially written command ledger.
contract.manifest: New post-experiment publication_provenance.json: schema, publication timestamp, original training/eval freeze hashes, immutable scientific source hashes, and entries with logical artifact id, original repo-relative logical path, original_sha256, published_path, published_sha256, kind, transform_version, allowed JSON pointers and local semantic verification status. No absolute original replacement strings, secrets or old home prefixes in public manifest.
contract.hash_domains: Historical *_sha256 values remain historical. Current PUBLICATION_SHA256SUMS and new publication manifest authenticate published bytes. Original->published relation is a publisher attestation unless original bytes are also public; say so.
contract.json_transform: No generic textual replace. Change only declared path-string values or explicitly allowlisted absolute runtime-path keys; reject unknown path forms, collisions and arbitrary key deletion. Preserve exact JSON types; compare float64 bits including -0.0; numbers and arrays are untouched. Never alter hash-valued strings.
contract.raw_relation: For every pair, locally verify original enriched minus v25 equals original raw, published enriched minus v25 equals published raw, and windows/assignments/pairing hashes are identical across original and published. Keep v25.original_raw_sha256 equal to ORIGINAL raw digest; map to PUBLISHED raw digest in publication manifest.
contract.cpu_replay: Use Python stdlib only: verify published manifest paths/hashes and unchanged scientific source/model byte hashes; load exact 46 holdout records+freeze+summary; audit_evaluation_records(records,freeze); compare_summary(summary,canonical). Do not invoke simulator runners, full audit CLI, model unpickling or summarizer CLI.
contract.what_cpu_proves: Published raw-array protocol, full fixed matrix, paired metadata consistency, final-distance/F32 success masks, all counts/cells/gates/legacy contrasts and agreement with published summary; integrity of listed public file bytes.
contract.what_cpu_does_not_prove: No fresh GPU execution, training replay, private original-byte availability, original cache mesh integrity, tensor contents through unpickling, external runtime code identity, or cryptographic proof of original-to-projection equivalence without public originals.
contract.secrets: Do not publish credentials/tokens/cookies, signed auth URLs, env dumps, plugin/session databases, .omx, fleet telemetry, home paths, raw console stdout/stderr, unreviewed JSONL commands or raw WORK/logs wholesale. Publish only explicitly selected sanitized commands and bounded structured evidence. Scan strings AND keys; do not use this review as a completed secrets audit.
